snippet.title: Monster Hunter Wilds - February 2026 Update
snippet.description:
The February update for Monster Hunter Wilds arrives on Wednesday, 18 February, 2026! Take on imposing new challenges with Arch-Tempered Arkveld, 10-star Arch Tempered Monsters, and unique new Event Quests! 

The update also adds a collaboration event with Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection, the weapon and pendant designs from the Design Contest, and an event celebrating the 1st anniversary.

Get now:
https://www.monsterhunter.com/wilds/en-au/product/

Official website:
https://www.monsterhunter.com/wilds/en-au/
-------
About Monster Hunter Wilds
Monster Hunter Wilds is the next generation of the acclaimed Monster Hunter series.

You are a monster hunter, protecting the balance of the ecosystem and hunting monsters in a world with dynamic, ever-changing environments. Use the resources you gain from hunts to craft ever more powerful weapons and armor in your quest to unravel the mysteries of the new lands.

Experience the most evolved action and improved immersion in the series in Monster Hunter Wilds, available now on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC/Steam!
